title: Episode 1: Flowers
text:
KATIE: OK. Here you are. Two cokes...
CUSTOMER: Thanks.
SHARON: Hiya Katie, you can go.
KATIE: Great, thanks Sharon. Have you seen Rich?
SHARON: Nope. He hardly ever comes in here now. He's in his office all the time. Dunno what's wrong with him. It's like he's avoiding the place.
KATIE: Hmmm.
SHARON: Who are the flowers from, by the way?
KATIE: Huh? What flowers?
SHARON: Didn't you see? There's a big bouquet of flowers for you in the back room of the club.
KATIE: What?!
SHARON: Yeah, a guy came and delivered them this evening. There wasn't a note or anything!
KATIE: Oh.
SHARON: Hey, do you think it's your ex-boyfriend? The guy who was in here last week?
KATIE: I don't think so... Mark never gave me flowers in the three years we were together. He doesn't like doing things like that. No, it can't be Mark.
SHARON: Wow, how exciting! You must have a real secret admirer Katie! Just like in the movies!
KATIE: Hmm, great. Well, I'd better go and see them I guess.
SHARON: Hey, why are you so down? I'd like someone to send me flowers.
KATIE: Hm. They're beautiful, all my favourites, in one bouquet!
RICH: Oh, hi Katie.
KATIE: Yeah, hi Rich. Haven't seen you for a while.
RICH: Yes. Well babe, I've been like pretty busy actually.
KATIE: Congratulations on the wedding.
RICH: Thanks.
RICH: Nice flowers. Who are they for?
KATIE: Me.
RICH: Oh.
KATIE: Err... just tell me Rich. Are these from you?
RICH: Hey, sorry but no. It ain't me, babe.
KATIE: Oh.
RICH: Anyway, I'd better go.
KATIE: Yeah, me too. Bye. Mmmm. Maybe I really do have a secret admirer.

title: Episode 2: Ice Cream Commercial
text:
CHUCK: Vanilla dream ice-cream, take one!
KATIE: Mmm, it's really delicious!
CHUCK: Did we really choose her? Say it like you mean it babe! You've only got three words to say, so say 'em right!
KATIE: OK, oh, sorry.
CHUCK: Vanilla dream ice-cream, take two!
KATIE: Mmm, it's really delicious!
CHUCK: Oh my, oh my... this is unbelievable!
MM: It's OK Chuck, relax, let me have a word with Katie. Hey, Katie, you're doing well. Look, don't worry about him, he loves being tough on actors. Look - take a deep breath, relax and try to ... keep it natural. They want your accent Katie, just your normal, charming English accent.
KATIE: OK, right, yeah... thanks. Relax, natural, OK.
MM: Just try to relax. Forget the cameras are even here.
CHUCK: OK, can we take it from the top please? Vanilla dream ice-cream, take three!
KATIE: Mmm, it's really delicious!
CHUCK: OK, hmm, not bad, yeah... OK... that's it, it's a wrap!
KATIE: Great. I can go then?
CHUCK: Yeah babe. That's it. We'll call you if anything else comes up.
KATIE: Really? That would be fantastic.
MM: Katie, I knew you could do it. You're a natural!
KATIE: Thanks Michael, I couldn't have done it without you.
MM: By the way, did you get the flowers I sent you?
KATIE: You sent them?
MM: Of course.
KATIE: There wasn't a note...
MM: Really? I wrote one. The flower company must have forgotten it. Hmm.
KATIE: Well, I did get them and they were gorgeous. Thanks a lot.
MM: No problem, my pleasure. Have you got time for a coffee?
KATIE: Sure. Let's go!

title: Episode 3: The Wedding Dress
text:
KATIE: Wow Sal, look at that one in the window. It's perfect!
SAL: Do you really think so? Shall we go in? It looks a bit expensive.
KATIE: Don't worry, come on let's go in and have a look anyway.
SA: Hi, can I help you?
SAL: Um, yes ... we're looking for a wedding dress.
SA: Well, you're in the right store! We've got a huge selection. Who's the bride to be?
SAL: It's me, but my cousin is going to be my bridesmaid.
KATIE: Am I? Sal, I thought it was just going to be a small wedding.
SAL: Oh, come on Katie, I'm only going to get married once in my life... I hope (!)... so I want it to be a bit special. You'll be my bridesmaid won't you?
KATIE: Yeah, of course I will Sal. I'd love to.
SA: Have you seen anything you like?
SAL: Well, I like the dress in the shop window. Could I try it on?
SA: Of course. I think this one is your size. What colour do you want? This one comes in pure white, ivory and red. They say red is THE colour for wedding dresses this season.
KATIE: Red would be fun! Try it on in red Sal!
SAL: OK, I'll try the red one.
SA: Here you are. The changing rooms are just here. Call me if you need any help.
SAL: Thanks.
KATIE: Are you ready Sal?
SAL: Yes, here I come! Ta da!
KATIE: Wow! You look amazing! And I mean AMAZING!
SAL: You really think so? Do you think Rich will like it?
KATIE: Like it? He's going to love it!
SAL: Well, let's look at a few more shops before we decide. I just saw the price tag and this one is $699 dollars!
KATIE: Urgg OK, let's keep looking, but I think we've already found the dress for you Sal.
SAL: I'll get changed. Wait here okay?
KATIE: Okay.
KATIE: Hello?
RICH: Hi Katie.
KATIE: Rich?!
SAL: What? Did you call me?
KATIE: No, no. Just my phone. What do you want?
RICH: To talk to you. Now.

title: Episode 4: Rich's Phone Call
text:
RICH: We need to talk Katie. You know that.
KATIE: Rich! This isn't exactly a good time.
RICH: Why not?
KATIE: Well, I'm a bit busy. I'm with my COUSIN, your future WIFE.
RICH: Oh. What are you doing?
SAL: Katie!! Are you all right? Can you come here and help me with this?
KATIE: Yes! Yes. Just a minute. I'm on the phone. I'll ... I'll be right there. We're shopping for her WEDDING dress Rich.
RICH: I know. But we need to talk about us.
KATIE: Us? There IS no us. You've been ignoring me for the past week.
RICH: I just... I just... I didn't know how to talk to you about it. I'm a bit confused.
KATIE: Confused?!
RICH: Well, yeah. What happened in the parking lot, I mean... there was something there... you have to admit it...
KATIE: I can't believe this!
RICH: You can't believe this. I can't believe this. But it's there. We have to... we have to deal with it.
KATIE: You're marrying my cousin! Does she know what happened?
RICH: What. About us? No. No way. No.
KATIE: Hmm.
RICH: You haven't told her anything, have you?
KATIE: No, but... I don't like this... you should tell her...
RICH: Hey, be cool. She doesn't have to know. What she doesn't know can't hurt her.
KATIE: Rich. I can't talk to you right now.
RICH: OK, when?
SAL: Katiee! Get off the phone and help me with this dress!
KATIE: Rich, I have to go.
RICH: When can we meet... when can I see you...
KATIE: Goodbye!
SAL: Who was that Katie? Mark? Michael? Heh, are you OK? You look really pale!
KATIE: I'm fine, no it was just an old friend. It's a bit hot in here... can we go?

title: Episode 5: The Internet Cafe
text:
KATIE: Hi, how much is it to use the Internet?
ASST: One dollar every ten minutes.
KATIE: OK, which computer?
ASST: Computer number three.
KATIE: Thanks.
MARK: Katie?
KATIE: Mark! Hi.
MARK: What are you doing here?
KATIE: Umm, just checking my Facebook page.
MARK: Oh.
CANDY: Mark...?
MARK: Oh yeah. Sorry. Katie, this is Candy. Candy, this is Katie.
CANDY: It's so nice to meet you Katie.
KATIE: Hello. Yes. It's nice to... um... meet you too.
CANDY: I've heard so much about you!
KATIE: Really?
CANDY: Yeah! From Mark.
KATIE: How, um, did you meet each other?
MARK: Well, I was uh, I was at a...
CANDY: We met at an LA Galaxy game.
KATIE: You're a football fan?
CANDY: I love soccer.
MARK: Yes. We just met, and erm...
CANDY: Well Mark. Aren't you going to tell her?
MARK: Ummm...
KATIE: Tell me what?
CANDY: Mark is taking me back to England with him. Isn't that totally amazing? We're going to see a Manchester United game. In Manchester!
KATIE: That sounds great.
MARK: Yeah. Candy's really looking forward to it.
CANDY: I'm totally looking forward to it. I'm so bored with life here in the US. It's totally boring. England is going to be so much more interesting for me.
KATIE: Really? I don't know...
CANDY: You know, I just feel like I totally need to change my life. Do you know what I mean?
KATIE: Yes, I suppose.
CANDY: Anyway, and Mark is so sweet.
KATIE: Mmm.
MARK: Anyway, Katie. It's uh, it's good to see you again.
KATIE: Thanks. Good luck. And good luck to you too... Candy.
CANDY: Thanks!
MARK: I uh, I hope it all works out for you here in Los Angeles. With your new boyfriend.
KATIE: Boyfriend?
MARK: Rich. The guy that threw me out of the club.
KATIE: What?
MARK: I saw you and Rich kissing in the car park.
KATIE: You... He's... He's not my boyfriend!
MARK: Whatever. It's okay. I just hope you're happy. Goodbye Katie.
CANDY: Goodbye. So nice to meet you.
KATIE: Yeah. Bye.

title: Episode 6: Asked on a Date
text:
SAL: So, Mark's going back to England. With a new girlfriend.
KATIE: Yeah. Well, I hope he's happy.
KATIE: Oh, Sal. After Mark and that girl left the Internet cafe, I got a phone call.
SAL: Really? Who?
KATIE: From Michael.
SAL: Michael? You mean the poet guy?
KATIE: Yes! And do you know what?
SAL: What?
KATIE: We're going out this Friday!
SAL: No way. That's great Katie. Where are you going?
KATIE: We're going to a restaurant he knows. I can't remember the name, but it's something Latin American.
SAL: Really? Are you going to go dancing too?
KATIE: No, we're going to an art gallery afterwards. There's a kind of party there.
SAL: Art gallery? Ugh. Boring.
KATIE: I don't think so. I think it's going to be really interesting.
SAL: So... What are you going to wear?
KATIE: Oh, I don't know. I haven't thought about that yet.
SAL: Oh, come on. It is a date.
KATIE: OK, I'll wear something nice but I'm not going to worry like some schoolgirl.
SAL: Well that's great. It makes me remember Rich. I mean, on our first date.
KATIE: Oh. Yeah.
SAL: He took me to a club and we danced all night. It was so much fun.
KATIE: Yeah? Sounds great.
SAL: He's been a bit strange though recently. I mean, a bit distant.
KATIE: Oh.
SAL: Do you think he's nervous about getting married?
KATIE: Err. I... I don't know. Maybe he's just busy at work.
SAL: Yes, maybe. Has he said anything to you about it?
KATIE: Um. No. We haven't talked recently.
SAL: Oh well. I'm not going to worry about it either. Hey, if you want, you can wear my new top on your date.
KATIE: What? You mean the black and silver one? Really?
SAL: Sure. Go and try it on now.
KATIE: Oh, Sal, you're the best! Thanks so much.

title: Episode 7: The Cop
text:
KATIE: Thanks again for dinner.
MM: It was my pleasure. Don't keep saying thank you.
KATIE: And that gallery! It was great. Really great.
MM: I'm glad you liked it.
KATIE: What's that?
MM: Hmmm. It's the police. Right behind us.
KATIE: Do they want us to pull over?
MM: I think so. Strange. I wasn't driving very fast. Hold on.
MM: Yes, hello? Is everything all right?
PO: Licence and registration please.
MM: Of course. Here you are. Is everything all right?
PO: Get out of the car please.
KATIE: What's the matter?
PO: Get out of the car. Now.
MM: Fine, but I'd like to know...
PO: Don't you understand English? Out of the car! RIGHT NOW!
KATIE: This is ridiculous!
MM: Don't worry. I'm getting out of the car.
PO: Keep your hands where I can see them.
MM: Fine, fine.
KATIE: What has he done?
PO: Now PUT YOUR HANDS ON THE FRONT OF THE CAR. Nice and slow.
KATIE: What are you doing? What has he done?
PO: Stay in the car ma'am. Just stay in the car.
MM: Listen, I'm...
PO: Be quiet. I'm just checking if you have a weapon.
MM: I don't have a weapon.
PO: I said be quiet! Or do you want us to go to the police station?
MM: No.
PO: What did you say?
MM: I said no. We don't want to go to the police station.
PO: Ok, we're done here. You can get back into the car.
KATIE: Excuse me, but what was all that about?
PO: Sorry ma'am, we're looking for a man... we thought it was him.
KATIE: Why, just because he's black?
PO: Do you want to make a complaint ma'am?
MM: Katie, just leave it.
KATIE: But he... this is...
PO: Have a nice evening then. Drive carefully.
KATIE: Arghhh! I can't believe that! Are you okay?
MM: I'm fine. Just fine. Let me take you home.

title: Episode 8: The Answerphone
text:
MM: Hello. This is Michael Mensah's cell phone. I can't take your call right now, so please leave a message and I'll call you back.
KATIE: Hi Michael, it's Katie. Um, I just wanted to say thanks for a great evening... well, I mean, most of the evening was great, apart from the incident... total nightmare. I couldn't believe it! I can't stop thinking about how horrid they were to you. Anyway, I um, I hate speaking to answerphones, so um, yeah, bye!
MM: Hello. This is Michael Mensah's cell phone. I can't take your call right now, so please leave a message and I'll call you back.
KATIE: Hi Michael, it's me again... Katie. I guess you're busy. Anyway, I just wanted to say I didn't mean the evening was a total nightmare. Not at all. I meant to say it was great, and well, you know I wondered if you wanted to go out again one day? So, uh, just let me know. I think you've got my number? So, um, have a nice day! Have a nice day??? Did I really say that? What an idiot! Oh, I hate answerphones!
MM: Hello. This is Michael Mensah's cell phone. I can't take your call right now, so please leave a message and I'll call you back.
KATIE: Hi again, it's me. Now I think about it, maybe you haven't got my number? Well, just in case it's 804 555 3261. Oh, of course you've got my number it'll be recorded on your mobile, won't it? Sorry... Yeah, um... sorry for bothering you again!
MM: Hello. This is Michael Mensah's cell phone. I can't take your call right now, so please leave a message and I'll call you back.
KATIE: Oh, not again!
MM: Hello. This is Michael Mensah's cell phone. I can't take your call right now, so please leave a message and I'll call you back.
KATIE: Hi. Yes, it's Katie again. Listen, are you all right? I'm a bit worried about you. You normally pick up your messages really quickly. Anyway, could you give me a ring and just let me know that everything is okay? Or, send me a quick text message? I'm a bit of a worrier. Sorry!

title: Episode 9: At the Club
text:
RICH: Katie uh, could you come into my office please?
KATIE: Um, I'm busy cleaning the bar.
RICH: Now please Katie!
KATIE: What is it now?
RICH: Katie, we've gotta talk about what happened in the parking lot. We can't just carry on as normal.
KATIE: Of course we can Rich. As far as I'm concerned NOTHING happened in the parking lot. I've forgotten it already and I wish you would too!
RICH: I just can't forget it Katie. I... I kinda felt something out there.
KATIE: Rich! You're about to marry Sal! Have you forgotten that? My cousin and best friend, Sal, remember her?
RICH: Of course I do Katie, but I can't believe you felt nothing.
KATIE: Well you'd better believe it! Zero... nothing... nada!
RICH: I don't believe you.
KATIE: Argh! What more can I say? What do you want Rich? Do you even want to marry my cousin?
RICH: Of course I wanna marry Sal. She's great.
KATIE: So what are you suggesting? You want to be with both of us?
RICH: I dunno... I don't... Can't we just see what happens?
KATIE: Have you talked to Sal about this? Maybe you should.
RICH: Wait a minute. There's NO WAY we're telling Sal. This is our secret Katie and it's gonna stay that way!
KATIE: That's what you think.
RICH: What did you say?
KATIE: Nothing. I've gotta get back to work.
RICH: You know what Katie? Don't worry about it. You can go home.
KATIE: What?! You're firing me?
RICH: Yes I am! Go now in fact.
KATIE: Right! That's it then, I'm unemployed again, great! I'll have to explain this to Sal, won't I?
RICH: What?!
KATIE: Well, she'll ask what happened won't she? She'll wonder why you fired me... and I may just have to tell her the truth!
RICH: Katie! Wait, Katie! Come back here now!

title: Episode 10: The Poem
text:
KATIE: Coming!
KATIE: I said, I'm coming. Yes, hello?! Oh.
MM: Hi Katie.
KATIE: Hi. Hi! Come in, come in.
MM: Thanks.
KATIE: Here, come through to the living room. Can I get you something to drink?
MM: No, I'm okay thanks.
KATIE: Are you sure? Cup of tea?
MM: Well, well okay then.
KATIE: I'll be back in a minute. I've just made some tea actually.
MM: Katie, I...
KATIE: Just a minute, I'll get the tea.
KATIE: Here we are.
MM: Thanks. Listen, Katie. I got your messages...
KATIE: What? Oh, the messages. Oh, I feel a bit silly about those. You're really busy and I... anyway... it sounded a bit...
MM: No, don't apologize. I should apologize. I guess I felt... I felt ashamed after what happened in the car.
KATIE: I understand. It was horrible.
MM: I don't know if you can really understand. But let's not talk about that. I'm sorry I didn't answer your calls.
KATIE: That's all right.
MM: No, it isn't all right. But I would like to make it up to you. Would you like to go out again?
KATIE: Yes. Of course.
MM: Well, it's your turn to choose the place.
KATIE: Hmm. You'll have to give me some time to think about it. After the amazing evening we had last time together...
MM: Yes. I have to go to work. But Katie.
KATIE: Yes?
MM: One more thing. This is for you.
KATIE: Oh! An envelope. What is it? Is it money?
MM: No, no. No, it's a poem. I wrote it for you. The other day. I wanted you to have it.
KATIE: Oh Michael.
MM: No, wait. I'd prefer if you read it later. I'll be embarrassed if you read it now.
KATIE: OK then.
MM: So, I'll call you.
KATIE: Promise?
MM: I promise. Bye. Thanks for the tea.
KATIE: Thanks for coming to visit.
KATIE: Oh. OH. That's so nice.

title: Episode 11: The Hen Night
text:
GG: Go Sal! Go Sal! Go Sal! Go Sal! Go Sal!
SAL: I can't wear this! You're all so mean! You mean I really have to put this on? For the whole evening?
KATIE: Come on Sal, it could be a lot worse than that! Remember what you made Claire wear on her hen night? This is nothing, come on, put it on!
SAL: Okay, okay. There we are. How do I look?
GIRL 1: Oooh, Sal, you look... uh... great!
GIRL 2: Is this what they do at bridal showers in England? Crazy stuff!
KATIE: Okay, before the evening really begins I'd like to say a few words. So, this time next week my cousin Sal will be a married woman! I just want to say that I think Rich is a very... very... very lucky man! So, to 'Sal and Rich'.
GG: Sal and Rich!
SAL: Thanks Katie, that was sweet of you.
KATIE: I mean it Sal, Rich is really lucky to be marrying you. Really lucky.
SAL: Why do you say it like that Katie? It sounds like you don't think he's good enough for me.
KATIE: Well... no, I've never said that Sal.
SAL: You didn't have to say it.
KATIE: What?
SAL: Come on, what's bugging you Katie? Tell me. I know there's something.
KATIE: Oh Sal, don't be silly. Come on, this is your hen night. We're out to have a good time!
SAL: Rich told me that you quit your job at the club.
KATIE: That I... what?
SAL: I can't believe you didn't tell me already. Rich is so upset about the whole thing. What's going on?
KATIE: Well, there was something I wanted to tell you Sal, but I don't think this is the time or the place.
SAL: Well I suggest we take a visit to the bathroom, right now Katie!
KATIE: Fine.
SAL: We'll be right back girls!

title: Episode 12: The Truth
text:
SAL: So, what did you want to tell me?
KATIE: Sal, this isn't easy to say. It really isn't.
SAL: Well, come on then. Spit it out. How bad can it be?
KATIE: It's about Rich.
SAL: Hmm. I thought so. What about him?
KATIE: I didn't quit the club. He fired me.
SAL: He fired you?
KATIE: Sal, Rich lied to you. He fired me. He told me to go.
SAL: Why would he do that?
KATIE: Well, there's something else. Do you remember the time that Mark showed up at the club?
SAL: Yes. And Rich threw him out. You told me.
KATIE: Yes. Well, after that, Rich came to see me. I was outside, in the car park...
SAL: Yes...
KATIE: And I was feeling awful, you know, all confused and...
SAL: And...?
KATIE: And, well, Rich gave me a hug but then... something happened and suddenly we were...
SAL: You were what?
KATIE: We were kissing. We stopped, and I wanted to tell you the next day but...
SAL: But what? You and my boyfriend, my future husband, were... were...
KATIE: It's not like that Sal. It was just once. But Rich keeps going on to me about it.
SAL: Going on about it? What do you mean?
KATIE: I don't know. He said there was something between us. But there isn't. We had a fight about it though, I said he should tell you.
SAL: And what did he say?
KATIE: That's when he fired me. Sal, it was nothing. It really was nothing. But I thought you should know the truth.
SAL: You thought I should know the truth.
KATIE: Yes. Before it's too late.
SAL: And so you waited until now, two days before the wedding, to tell me.
KATIE: Yes.
SAL: Get out.
KATIE: What?
SAL: Get out. Get out. Leave me alone.
KATIE: Sal, wait a minute. I...
SAL: I said, GET OUT!
KATIE: Oh! Ohhh!

title: Episode 13: A Shoulder to Cry On
text:
MM: ...but Katie, I just don't get it. Why would Rich fire you? You're great at your job.
KATIE: Oh ... something happened, Michael. Look, I don't really want to talk about it right now.
MM: Okay, don't worry. So, what's your plan now?
KATIE: Well, the fact is I've really messed up this time. Maybe I should just go back to England.
MM: What? Give up now? Just when you're settling in? Don't be silly. There are lots of jobs out there. You could do whatever you like.
KATIE: Well yeah, I guess I could...
MM: So, look on the bright side. Here's your chance. You could try something completely new... how about going to drama school? You were great in the ice-cream advert. You'd be a great actress.
KATIE: Really? No, I don't think acting's for me. But going to college here is an interesting idea... I could get a student visa...
MM: That's more like it! A positive attitude! There are some great schools in LA.
KATIE: Oh, it's Sal. Hi Sal!
SAL: Hi Katie. Can you talk?
KATIE: Yeah, sure. How are you doing?
SAL: Well, you know... okay I guess. Listen, Rich and I have had a long chat and I think we're going to be okay.
KATIE: Oh Sal, I am so pleased. I've been feeling terrible... I mean, really terrible.
SAL: Okay, okay, don't start apologizing again please, we've 'been there and done that'! So, are you going to come over to help me or what? There's lots to do before the big day!
KATIE: Oh, I'd love to Sal! I'm on my way! Michael, I'm so sorry, that was Sal and she really needs me right now. Do you mind...?
MM: Of course not Katie. You go. I'll phone you later.
KATIE: Thanks Michael, you're a star. See you soon, and thanks for listening.

title: Episode 14: The Morning
text:
KATIE: Sal, you look beautiful!
SAL: You've been saying that all morning. Stop it!
KATIE: I know, but it's true.
SAL: Oh wait. The flowers, where are the flowers?
KATIE: Here they are. Here they are. Okay, let me look at you again. Ohhhh...
KATIE: Hello? All right. All right. We're coming.
SAL: What?
KATIE: It's your father. He says he's been waiting for fifteen minutes. We're going to be late.
SAL: Isn't the bride supposed to be late?
KATIE: You're right.
KATIE: Sal...?
SAL: Okay, let's go.
KATIE: Wait, you're crying. What's the matter?
SAL: Nothing... I... I just...
KATIE: Do you want to talk about it?
SAL: What if I'm making a mistake!
KATIE: Oh Sal...
SAL: Don't say 'Oh Sal' to me. You of all people probably think I'm making a mistake.
KATIE: No, I'm sure...
SAL: What?
KATIE: I'm sure you will make Rich very happy.
SAL: But will he make me happy? Maybe this is all wrong...
KATIE: I took the road less travelled by, and that has made all the difference.
SAL: What? What are you saying?
KATIE: It's from a poem that Michael told me. It's about making difficult decisions, I think.
SAL: The road less travelled...
KATIE: Sal, we'd better go. Forget about what I said.
SAL: Oh... okay. Let's go then.

title: Episode 15: The Wedding
text:
MM: Katie. Over here!
KATIE: Hi.
MM: How's the bride?
KATIE: Ok, I think. She's a bit nervous.
MM: Thank you for inviting me. I've never been to a wedding at City Hall before.
KATIE: Thanks for coming. I don't think it's going to be very long. Oh. Here's Rich.
RICH: Hi Katie.
KATIE: Hi.
KATIE: Oh, Rich. This is Michael.
MM: Nice to meet you. Congratulations!
RICH: Yeah. Thanks and nice to meet you too. Where's Sal? Is she going to keep the groom waiting?
KATIE: Look, here she is.
RICH: Wow, babe. You look beautiful. This is it!
OFFICIAL: Good afternoon everybody. My name's Denise McKinnon. Shall we begin?
RICH: Yep.
SAL: Yes.
OFFICIAL: Will you both state your names, for the record?
RICH: Richard Andrew Marks.
SAL: Sally Elizabeth Clarkson.
OFFICIAL: Richard Andrew Marks, do you take Sally Elizabeth Clarkson to be your wife? Will you love, honour, and cherish her, in good times and in bad, and do you promise to stay true to her as long as you both shall live?
RICH: I do.
OFFICIAL: Sally Elizabeth Clarkson, do you take Richard Andrew Marks to be your husband? Will you love, honour, and cherish him, in good times and in bad, and do you promise to stay true to him as long as you both shall live?
SAL: I...
OFFICIAL: You need to say "I do".
SAL: I...

title: The End 1
text:
RICH: Sal!
MM: Katie, what's wrong with your cousin?
KATIE: I don't know. Sal!
SAL: I took the road less travelled by, and that has made all the difference.
RICH: What?!
OFFICIAL: I don't understand.
SAL: I'm sorry, Rich. I love you, but I can't marry you. I can't spend my life with a person I can't trust.
RICH: Sal!
KATIE: Sal!
SAL: I'm sorry everyone, the wedding is off. Katie, let's get out of here.
RICH: Saaaal!

title: The End 2
text:
SAL: I do.
OFFICIAL: And now, I pronounce that you are husband and wife. Richard, you may kiss your bride!
RICH: With pleasure. Sal, I'm so happy. Are you happy?
SAL: Yes, yes I am. Everybody, we're married!
MM: Well, Katie. That was great. I think they look good together.
KATIE: You do? Well, I hope they'll be happy. What a year it's been.
MM: Have you thought about what you want to do?
KATIE: I'm going to stay here. I've applied for a course at the University of Berkeley.
MM: Really? That's great! What course?
KATIE: A drama course.
MM: I thought you said you didn't want to act.
KATIE: I know. But I think it could be for me. Maybe it's...
MM: Yes?
KATIE: Maybe it's the road less travelled.
MM: Maybe it is. Maybe it is.
